4. Analyze the structural defects of each bridge component.
5. Assign appropriate defect codes to each identified defect.
6. Ensure that the defect codes reflect the existing shape of components.
7. Provide a comprehensive evaluation of the bridge's overall condition based on the recorded defects.
8. Review the report before submission to ensure accuracy and completeness.
